title: fp-evidence.json
description: Self-report answers for a system that adopts the Lyrikai Fibonacci Protocol for UI/UX Design Agents, version 1.0.0-rc.5. Kept beside fp.config.json. MIT License. https://www.lyrikai.com . Defined by rule FP-CONF-06 in spec/03-conformance.md.

fp.description: The version string of the specification the answers were given against, in full. It equals fp in fp.config.json.

adopter.description: Who is making the claim: a person, a team or an organisation.

items.description: One entry for each applicable self-report rule, keyed by rule ID.

result.description: pass: the rule is met. fail: it is not; the run fails. n/a is accepted only for a rule that the configuration already makes not applicable; on an applicable rule it fails conf.evidence (FP-CONF-06), because applicability is decided by fp.config.json alone.

evidence.description: Text, a file path or a URL that shows the result. An empty string leaves the rule open.

independent.description: True only when by is neither the adopter nor a person or agent working for the adopter (FP-CONF-14). This is a statement by whoever writes the file; a checker reads it and cannot verify it.
